name: Trace With Me
description: Handwriting: letters, numbers and shapes to color in, words to trace and spell from memory, and cursive with a pen that shows each stroke.

about.concept: Handwriting as movement memory. Letters, numbers and words are traced stroke by stroke with the correct order and direction shown, then written from memory, so the motor pattern and the spelling are learned together.
about.progression: Shapes and single letters come first, then numbers, then words to trace and spell from memory, then cursive with a pen that shows each stroke joining the next.
